visualCharacteristics: Two-column product layout: left cell a large product image, right cell an SKU eyebrow, product title heading, short description, a 'Where to Buy' CTA button, and a bulleted selling-features list with check icons. Stacks to a single column on mobile with the image first.
contentPattern: One row, two cells: image | product info (heading + paragraph + link + list). Optional following row for a badge beneath the image.
usage: Product detail pages — primary product identity/media grid (#PDPGrid).
